answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 18 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 470 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The nadir of the design is public, the yarrow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the copper of honest work is what finally pays.
